title: [.NET] Load assemblies directly from PCK on Android

labels.name: cherrypick:4.4
labels.description: Considered for cherry-picking into a future 4.4.x release

body: Fixes #105832. Addresses limitations observed after #105262 ("Avoids using assemblies extracted to a temporary directory in Android."), where testing confirmed the cache directory was still referenced. Assemblies are now loaded directly from the PCK (`res://`) instead of a cache directory. This prevents runtime failures that occurred when the OS cleared cached files (e.g., under low storage), ensuring the required assemblies are always available.
